subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Physical Game Show Phenomenon
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Physical Game Show Phenomenon.

hook.text: Japan invented the physical game show with Takeshi's Castle in 1986.

buildup.text: Shows like Ninja Warrior and Wipeout adapted the format globally.

discovery.text: The format requires no translation. A person falling into mud is funny in every language.

twist.text: Korean and Japanese physical game shows inspired Squid Game.

climax.text: Physical game shows prove that some television transcends culture entirely.

quiz.question: Why are physical game shows considered the most exportable TV format?
options: Physical comedy and spectacular failure are universally entertaining and require no translation
